summary_markdown: The discussion covered two main topics: conversion tracking logic and required impression attributes. Regarding conversions, the participants clarified that cross-sensor conversions should be tracked from sensors near a pier to JCD sensors in the city, or vice versa (Dscreens to store sensors). A specific clarification was made regarding the difference between Dscreens and JCD, noting they are separate Latvian companies. For impression data, [me] provided a VA template containing attributes like `facility_id`, `frame_id`, `road_id`, `dwell-time`, etc., which might be relevant for Brazil. Finally, it was agreed that the participants would schedule a call with someone (Galina) to determine the correct set of impression attributes needed.
decisions: Conversion tracking logic confirmed: Pier sensors -> JCD city sensors, or Dscreens -> store sensors.
A follow-up meeting will be scheduled with Galina to finalize required impression attributes.
action_items: Participants to schedule a call with Galina regarding impression data requirements.
